classification: retrospective exploratory hypothesis, proposed after inspection of R46/R49; this is not independent discovery or confirmatory evidence

decision_rules.fail_closed: Any unrecovered event list, ambiguous announcement time/effective date, unverified membership provenance, or missing/duplicate required rows stops the return study. Do not drop inconvenient events or relax these gates after seeing outcomes.
decision_rules.interpretation: Passing establishes only data feasibility. Any return analysis requires a separate panel registration and frozen analysis specification first.
pass_to_next_stage_only_if: All 17 routine events have an independently auditable official addition list, publication date, and after-close effective date.
Every event window has complete daily-bar row coverage for all included additions, with duplicate and missing code-date rows reported.
The announced additions can be distinguished from pre-event members using data whose source and as-of timing are documented.
A valid control universe can be formed from information available by each announcement date.

hypothesis: After CSI publicly announces routine HS300 constituent additions, additions may exhibit positive equal-weight drift from the first executable session after the publication date until the last session before after-close implementation, relative to a pre-specified market and industry control. This round only checks event-list and data coverage and will not inspect price, return, or performance fields.

motivation_and_bias.disclosure: Those results motivated this post hoc pre-implementation question. They are not evidence for this hypothesis, and this sample must be treated as exploratory.
prior_work: R49 did not find a significant result after style matching.

candidate.name: R304-A14 公告至生效前调入股漂移可行性（事后假设，无收益）

panel.method: GET current panel and save raw response; require exactly the 20 IDs/statuses in the frozen A11 readback plus the unique pending A13 candidate recorded in its registration proof; verify no duplicate R304-A14; save one exact POST intent; issue one POST with no retry; GET readback and save raw response; verify the new candidate is unique and pending and every pre-existing status is unchanged.

prohibited: No OHLCV, adjusted-price, or return reads in this round.
No backtest, factor calculation, alpha scan, or candidate performance update.
No live official-network request during panel registration.
No changes to production data, strategies, cache, or existing candidate statuses.

scope.event_timing: Use the official publication calendar date and stated after-close effective date. The candidate return window, if a later separately registered analysis is approved by its feasibility gate, begins at the first executable session strictly after publication and ends at the final session strictly before implementation.
scope.event_universe: 17 routine semiannual HS300 adjustment announcements from 2018-06 through 2026-06, including notice 14225 (2022-06). Exclude separately classified temporary adjustments in 2025-02, 2025-07, and 2026-09.
scope.this_round_only: Recover and reconcile the addition/removal code lists, verify event date boundaries, and inspect only date/code/schema/row-presence coverage in local historical membership and daily-bar storage. Do not read OHLCV, adjusted prices, returns, performance metrics, or calculate any return.
